label: early-sequence / <DEL> step after a prefix dominated by h,1,v,m,j,k,b
explanation: Fires almost only in the original phase and at the <DEL> step, at steps t=2..5 (never at t=0, rare in the copy phase, about 7% of mass). The <DEL> step holds 39% of the mass and is strongest for short sequences (L=3-4); the top activations are all <DEL> after 2-4 tokens. Firing depends on which tokens came before: prefixes made mostly of h, 1, v, m, j, k, b (h strongest, at 7x lift as prev_tok/prev2_tok/first_tok) raise it. Predicate: at most one earlier input outside that set. On dev it captures 65% of the mass but precision is only 0.12, so most such prefixes do not fire it; the magnitude looks like a graded readout of the hidden state rather than a crisp condition. Restricting to <DEL> with L<=4 gives precision 0.51 but only 23% of the mass. It does not fire at t=0 or late in long sequences.
